text.p: These are the leading stories in the Turkish press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Turkish songwriter arrested for allegedly obtaining false passport for two rebel Kurds.
- Islamist sect leader says the Islamist-led government has failed and should call elections.
- MPs and ministers of the government's Islamist wing in Saudi Arabia for the Haj went against the grain of private prayers in their own tents by holding mass prayers.
- Turkish and Greek pop singers to give a concert on the "Green Line" dividing the two communities in Cyprus.
- Widow of late far-right leader Alparslan Turkes said she should be consulted on decisions over the procedures for electing his replacement.
- The International Monetary Fund will monitor a new economic programme drawn up by the Islamist-led government.
- Mourners marked the fourth anniversary of the death of late president Turgut Ozal.
